web.title: Ryusei (competition) - Wikipedia
web.description: The Ryusei is a Go competition used by the Japanese Nihon-Kiin. It was started in 1991 and is a fast go tournament. The tournament consists of four sections.

web.title: Women Creating Stir In Japanese Ryusei - American Go Association
web.description: The Ryusei is a fast-play -- 30 seconds per move plus 10 one-minute thinking periods -- event that's broadcast on TV and draws a large audience.
